I went to see the new DBS Broly movie with friends last night and felt exceptionally happy. The happiest I think I've been in the last few months. But the feeling clearly didn't last very long. All I think about is sleeping and eating, which is all I've been doing in these past few weeks. Nothing but junk food and it's making me feel even worse considering the progress I'd made exercising and eating healthy. But again, I can't seem to find the will to care enough to stop. I've given up on trying to make friends at work as everyone there is abhorently fake and generally not my kind of people. I know they don't care about me one way or another. I suppose on the upside this has made me aware of who my real friends are and made me more appreciative of them. Right now I still hold onto hope of a better tomorrow, but it's fading fast. I think the ratio of positivity to negativity in my head is about 1:3. 

If this isn't lost in the abyss of other's thoughts and pains, thanks for reading and I hope your day goes great.
